question_text: Write an ANSI SQL query to identify unstable pods with restarts > 0 and calculate their average CPU load from `container_metrics_8`.
correct_answer:
SELECT pod_name, MAX(restart_count) AS total_restarts, ROUND(AVG(cpu_usage_cores), 2) AS avg_cpu
FROM container_metrics_8
GROUP BY pod_name
HAVING MAX(restart_count) > 0
ORDER BY total_restarts DESC;
answer_explanation: Filters pods experiencing container crashes and restarts, computing their average CPU usage.
reference_solution:
